description: This file provides utilities for seeding a database with roles, competencies, and related relationship data from JSON files. It handles JSON loading, ensuring database tables exist, and performing idempotent upsert operations for various entities. The core function `seed_catalog_from_json` coordinates the seeding process, making it suitable for initial setup or re-seeding without duplication.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict[str,Any]]] _load_json(file_name: str)
methods.description: Loads a JSON array from a given filename inside the data directory, handling errors or invalid formats by returning None.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_tables(db: Session)
methods.description: Creates required catalog tables if they do not already exist, using SQL commands executed via SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_roles(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs an idempotent insert/update operation for role records based on the 'code' field, attempting to preserve IDs if provided.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert/update of competency records based on the 'code' field, with optional ID preservation.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_adjacency(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Creates or updates edges in the role adjacency table with weights, based on from_role_id and to_role_id.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Creates or updates role-competency requirement records, identified by composite primary key (role_id, competency_id).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] seed_catalog_from_json()
methods.description: Main function that loads the JSON data files and orchestrates the seeding (upsert) process for roles, competencies, role adjacency, and role competencies, ensuring proper order and atomicity.
